criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Ads board is job-specific and its stated framing includes product fidelity; no exact-ASIN validation.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Arena ranks outputs, but its recommendation quality has not been validated by AIVP.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Public job-specific boards materially narrow model selection; no export or routing integration.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Same briefs, fixed output selection, blind pairs and randomized position are documented; raw prompts/votes are incomplete.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Public boards are available; refresh latency and operational uptime are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Public browsing incurred no cost, but cost-adjusted model scoring is explicitly not yet included.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Public informational access exists; chart-reproduction and downstream model-output rights require separate confirmation.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: No public Arena API, export or webhook was verified.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Public boards directly address model-selection friction for creators and SMBs.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: High-intent comparison content fit exists; affiliate application is not approved.

analysis: Arena is useful as a job-specific model shortlist, but AIVP has not validated ranking predictive power, exact-product outcomes, cost-adjusted utility, raw benchmark reproducibility or automation.
confidence_notes: Primary benchmark documentation plus launch reporting; no AIVP-controlled validation run.
